beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Eden Was a Jungle examines how local goodness can export harm into the shared world.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its opening follows an orchard saved by water diverted toward other people.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: No villain is required for sensible private decisions to damage the valley.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks what morality becomes when attention, cooperation, survival, and power remain unevenly distributed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers enter a deliberately uncomfortable argument, then encounter the audit that tests its darkest claims.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The garden image challenges the assumption that cooperation automatically escapes competition.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A group may care deeply for members while passing costs beyond its boundary.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book follows this tension through trust, states, political narratives, and technological power.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its fictional situations make abstract mechanisms visible without pretending to be historical testimony.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These examples invite readers to examine whom an apparently generous arrangement leaves outside.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final audit refuses to equate successful survival with moral entitlement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A theory that reinterprets every kindness as predation may become impossible to disprove.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book also asks how ruthlessness destroys trust and information that continued success requires.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This internal challenge matters because cold language can disguise an emotional preference for darkness.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The full reading experience holds the force of the thesis beside its limits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the orchard, where ordinary care produces consequences beyond its reach.
